# Alfred Black platform

> Building and shipping Alfred Black, a managed AI butler/agent platform sold as a service — simultaneously David's product, primary tool, content subject, and personal infrastructure.

## Context

Alfred Black is the central project of David's professional life. It is a managed AI butler platform built on Hermes Agent (OpenClaw), Temporal workflows, and hosted on Hetzner. The tech stack spans Python, TypeScript/Node, Docker, Cloudflare Workers, Ghost CMS, and Supabase. David's GitHub (ssdavidai) has three core repos — alfred, alfred-platform, alfred-black — generating hundreds of CI/CD and deploy notifications per week. The AI API spend is substantial: OpenRouter at $15–105 per charge with multiple charges monthly, Anthropic at €180/month personal plus $200/month for the alfred@lumberjack.so Pro plan, xAI/Grok at $100 prepaid token purchases, and Hetzner hosting at $328.91/month.

The Design Partner Program is the current go-to-market motion. Zsolt Rapali is an active design partner who brought in Boris. Rami Khouri was offered a complimentary slot after previously consulting with David. Miguel Ortiz is getting his own Alfred instance and participates in regular sprint calls. Andrew Newton forked the Alfred template and independently built 'Salem,' his own AI instance. Revenue flows through Polar subscriptions (Premium/Pro/Starter tiers) with multiple subscribers renewing monthly.

The product occupies a unique position David himself recognizes as the 'dogfooding spiral': every improvement to Alfred is simultaneously product development and personal productivity gain. The Lumberjack post 'A year of fucking around' suggests self-awareness about this loop. Alfred is what David uses to manage his own life, what he sells to customers, and what he writes about — making it nearly impossible to draw boundaries between work and product.

A voice-first Alfred appears to be the next strategic frontier. The constellation of voice-related services — Vapi, AgentPhone, Retell AI, Deepgram, AssemblyAI, ElevenLabs, Wispr Flow, and the recently shipped Omi AI wearable — is disproportionate for a text-based butler. Combined with HeyGen for AI video and Tella recordings like 'Meet Alfred: The First Self-Onboarding AI Agent,' the trajectory points toward voice as the next interface layer.

RJ Johnson functions as the closest thing to a co-founder without the title: weekly Wednesday 6 AM syncs, active product testing, a paying Alfred Premium subscriber, and a $2,500 transfer that may represent advisory compensation or investment. The relationship predates Alfred Black and provides genuine strategic counsel from a US-market perspective.
